name: Hexes (Fields)
short_description: The hexagonal spaces that make up the battlefield.
long_description: Hexes, also called fields, are the individual spaces occupied by Tokens on the battlefield. A hex may provide terrain effects, contain Scrap or other Objects, and affect movement, attacks, abilities, and positioning.

name: Tokens
column6: and Objects present in the game.
column7: Tokens represent the warriors, commanders, creatures, and Objects used in play. Their CSV entries define statistics, attacks, abilities, keywords, and other rules. Combat Tokens participate in Battle, while Objects follow their own specific rules.

name: Cards
short_description: Playable effects that cost Actions and sometimes Scrap.
long_description: Cards provide effects beyond a Token's ordinary actions. Their entries define Action and Scrap costs, targeting rules, types, keywords, descriptions, and the scripts that implement their effects. Cards are drawn into a player's Hand and normally move to the Discard pile after use.

name: Game Zones
short_description: The areas that hold Tokens and Cards during play.
long_description: Game Zones organize the match. The battlefield holds deployed Tokens; the Reserve holds Tokens available for later deployment or creation; the Graveyard holds defeated Units; the Hand holds playable Cards; the Deck holds undrawn Cards; and the Discard pile holds used Cards. Specific effects may move game pieces between these zones.
